facts.fact: Revises F264: Devan orders Bhaskaran's men (four men, a cart and fodder) to leave Kettamala the morning after the return, reaching the kennels within three days of Neela's watering, then weekly while roads allow. Muthu offers to go himself and Devan answers 'After the sealing. I want you at the gate.' Muthu carries the later run (ch 31).
Neela watches the sealing arrival from the west rampart above the warden's chamber window, where the pulled sentry used to stand; the wall bends toward the gate so she overlooks the padippura.
